location_description:
Country Walk is a census-designated place (CDP) in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. The population was 15,997 at the 2010 census.


== Geography ==
Country Walk is located at 25°37′56″N 80°26′6″W (25.632332, -80.434956).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 2.8 square miles (7.3 km2), of which, 2.8 square miles (7.3 km2) of it is land and 0.36% is water.
